body: Structured triage findings submitted for trusted action evaluation.

data.audit: Read issue #290 body/comments; PR #238 diff/body (merged, adds `avm-utl-interfaces` v0.7.0 usage); PR #227 and #229 (related, unrelated to this specific request); verified `main.tf` currently contains `module.interfaces.lock_azapi.*` and `module.interfaces.role_assignments_azapi`. Compared must_compare issues #293, #289, #292, #291, #286, #287 — none related.
data.findings:
Feature request: consume `Azure/avm-utl-interfaces/azure` for lock/role-assignment payload construction instead of hand-built bodies. This is already implemented: PR #238 (merged 2026-08-19) replaces the handwritten lock/role-assignment body construction with `module.interfaces.lock_azapi.body` and the utility's role-assignment payloads, pinning `avm-utl-interfaces` v0.7.0. Verified against current `main.tf` in this checkout — `module.interfaces.lock_azapi.name`/`.body` and `module.interfaces.role_assignments_azapi` are present exactly as PR #238 describes, confirming the change is live on the default branch and resolves the request as stated.

Duplicate check: `.must_compare` candidates #293, #289, #292, #291, #286, #287 were opened. #289/#291/#292/#293 are distinct concurrent sandbox fixtures on unrelated topics (API version selection, RG tagging, managed-identity resource ID validation, custom role-assignment names) — not related. #286/#287 are retired unrelated fixtures from a prior cycle — not related. No duplicates found.

Related: PR #227 (merged 2026-08-18) wired the interface variants for lock/role-assignment inputs as a lint-fix precursor; PR #229 (merged 2026-08-19) added GUID validation on `principal_id` — both related-area but not the requested change itself.

Release: PR #238's merge commit is not yet contained in the latest published release (`v0.1.2`), so the fix is on `main` but unreleased.
